items.question: What tip, cornering, and nose-projection features must the pillar possess?
premises: The pillar is prescribed to have a well-formed tip.
The pillar is prescribed to be four-cornered.
The associated nose-projections are prescribed to be very small.
items.inference: A properly constructed pillar must combine a well-formed tip, four-cornered shape, and very small nose-projections.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of nāsikā in this context is not fully certain.
items.plain_english: The pillar should have a well-formed tip and be four-cornered, and its nose-projections should be very small.
